Introduction

Rubber Duckie is South Korean all-female indie rock band. The band was formed originally in 2004 in Bucheon, but went on hiatus a year later. The band returned to perform in Hongdae, Seoul in late 2009. In June 2013 Rubber Duckie collaborated on stage with another all-female indie rock band Swingz and formed project group Walking After U.
